description: Conduct an accessibility audit of a React web application to find and document WCAG violations. Use VSCode's search features to find images without proper alt attributes, buttons without accessible names, and form inputs without labels. Create a file named 'ACCESSIBILITY_AUDIT.md' in the workspace root (/home/ga/workspace/accessibility_audit/) containing your findings. The report should include: (1) a summary section with violation counts, (2) specific file paths and line numbers for each violation, (3) categorize violations by type (Missing Alt Text, Unlabeled Buttons, Unlabeled Inputs). Important: Images with alt="" (empty alt text) are decorative and should NOT be reported as violations - only report images that completely lack an alt attribute. Search in .jsx, .tsx, and .html files within the src/ directory.
